chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from him that he said:
"My father, peace be upon him, would sometimes make up twenty Witr prayers in a single night."

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, referring to the Imam’s father عليه السلام
key_terms.حَرِيزٌ: Ḥarīz, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him, an honorific for the Imam
key_terms.عِشْرِينَ: twenty; the number of Witr prayers mentioned
key_terms.قَضَى: made up; performed as qaḍāʾ after being missed

ai.seo_question: Can missed Witr prayers be made up in one night?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the father of the Imam عليه السلام would at times make up twenty Witr prayers in one night. It indicates the practice of qaḍāʾ for missed night worship and reflects the great devotion of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام in supererogatory salat (prayer).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1434 - Hariz narrated that Imam (as) said,
"My father (Imam (as)) would sometimes make up twenty Witr prayers in a single night."
